description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android View extending TextView that implements the LogNode interface. It's used to display log messages received through the LogNode interface, formatting log details such as priority, tag, message, and exceptions, and appending them to its display while also supporting chaining with other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface, formatting them for user readability and supporting chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log data and displays it within the LogView, handling different log priorities, optional exceptions, and ensuring thread-safe UI updates.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends the given string as a new line in the LogView display.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string and delimiter to a StringBuilder if the string is not null.
